factorization_contract: For occurrence indices i<j, R(i,j) is true iff both records describe authorization-policy rejection, their exact day fields match, and their exact tenant fields differ. No diagonal. Duplicate occurrences remain distinct.

records.text: Identity accepted. The policy engine refused the requested operation.
The signed-in member cannot perform this operation because their role lacks permission.
Authentication failed because the supplied password was wrong. Authorization was never reached.
The authentication token expired before identity verification. No authorization decision occurred.
Identity verification succeeded, but the requested resource is outside the caller's permitted scope.
The network connection failed before any authentication or authorization step.
The authenticated caller's role was forbidden from starting the job, and the policy check denied it.
Authentication and authorization both succeeded. The operation completed.
The caller was authenticated. An explicit access policy denied the attempted action.
The authenticated member lacked the required entitlement. The authorization service rejected the request.
A verified user's operation was refused by a role-based authorization rule.
A successful permitted operation was recorded. No request was rejected.
The caller proved their identity, but the permissions service denied access to the selected resource.
The authenticated account was blocked from this action by an authorization policy.
After successful authorization, the data parser rejected a malformed payload. No access-policy rejection occurred.
The user cancelled the operation before any request was submitted. No authorization decision occurred.

relation_cases.name: supersedes_b
relation_cases.evidence: Policy A explicitly replaces policy B. Policy C remains independently in force. There are no other replacement relations among A, B and C.

relation_cases.name: supersedes_c
relation_cases.evidence: Policy A explicitly replaces policy C. Policy B remains independently in force. There are no other replacement relations among A, B and C.
